how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From your first quote to delivery in Haiti - simple steps, clear expectations.

1.title: Pre-register online
1.body: Tell us what you are shipping, where it is going, and how you want it sent (air, ocean, or ground).

2.title: Drop off in Doral
2.body: Bring your packages to our Doral counter. We weigh, verify, and prepare your shipment.

3.title: Pay and we ship
3.body: After weighing you get a clear invoice. Once paid, your cargo moves on the next available leg.

4.title: Track to delivery
4.body: Use your tracking ID anytime for status updates until your recipient gets the package.

visit.title: Visit us in Doral
visit.subtitle: Walk-ins welcome for drop-off and questions. Call ahead if you are bringing oversized cargo.
visit.cardBody: Air and ocean schedules vary by week. After you submit a quote, our team confirms timing, required paperwork, and anything special about your cargo - so there are no surprises at the counter.

1.q: Do I need an account to get a quote?
1.a: No. You can complete the quote form first.

2.q: What happens after I submit a quote?
2.a: You bring your goods to Doral for weighing, then we invoice based on real weight and service.

3.q: How long do air and ocean take?
3.a: Typical ranges are about 5-7 business days for air and 14-21 for ocean.

4.q: Can you handle shopping purchases or door delivery?
4.a: Yes - we offer shopping assistance and local delivery options.

5.q: What should I bring to drop-off?
5.a: Bring your packed items, any invoices/declarations, and valid ID.

AdminSecurity.loginIntro: Staff: work email and password. Full admins: email code, then authenticator app codes on every sign-in. You will set up the app on your first login. Google sign-in is optional when enabled.
AdminSecurity.blockingBanner: You cannot use admin tools until authenticator enrollment is finished. Follow the numbered steps below, then use the button to scan the QR code and activate.
AdminSecurity.setupIntro: Full administrator accounts must use a one-time code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, etc.) every time you sign in after your email code. Complete the steps below once; then you can use the dashboard.
AdminSecurity.step1Body: On your phone, install Google Authenticator or any compatible app from your app store.
AdminSecurity.step2Body: Tap the button below to generate a QR code. Do not share it or take a screenshot where others can see it.
AdminSecurity.step3Body: In the app, choose “Add account” or “Scan QR code” and scan the code we show. If you cannot scan, use manual entry with the key shown on screen.
AdminSecurity.step4Body: Enter the 6-digit rotating code from the app and tap Enable. When you see confirmation, you are done — you can open any admin page.
AdminSecurity.afterSetup: You can change or review this in Settings when you need to.
AdminSecurity.accessDeniedBody: You do not have access to the admin dashboard. Only approved staff accounts can sign in.
